claims.quote: An earlier inquiry from our wholesale distribution team requested discovery about fragmented reporting. The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement. Please clarify the contradictory project information before proposing a meeting.

raw_proposal.draft:
Hi [Customer Name],

Thank you for your interest in Cedar Systems. We understand your team previously inquired about fragmented reporting and workflow coordination. However, we noticed some conflicting information regarding the current project status—specifically, that the project is paused and there is disagreement about the requirement.

Could you please clarify the current project status and requirements? This will help us ensure we align our next steps with your needs and provide the most relevant support.

Looking forward to your response.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Your Contact Information]
questions: What is the current status of the project?
Are there any specific requirements or concerns that need to be addressed before proceeding?
uncertainties: There is conflicting information about the project status and requirements.
The owner disagrees about the requirement, which needs clarification.
